Kill [[Kepkhet Marrowfeast]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in [[Prophet's Path]].
* *BONUS* Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
If you follow the path in the [[:File:Kepkhet Marrowfeast map.jpg|the map posted on the right]], you will only encounter [[Marrow Scarab]]s, [[Minotaur (Crystal Desert)|Minotaurs]], [[Rockshot Devourer]]s, and [[Scarab Nest Builder]]s on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. [[List of hex removal skills|Hex removal skills]] are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.

Avoid using [[condition]]-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use [[Plague Touch]] and then [[Virulence]]. Marrow Scarabs use [[Well of the Profane]], so either [[interrupt]] its [[activation]], avoid bringing [[enchantment]]s with long [[recharge time]]s, and/or move away from [[corpse]]s before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.

Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use [[Distracting Shot]], so skills that [[List of blocking skills|block]], inflict the [[blind]] condition, cause [[miss]]es, or [[Interrupt#Interrupt prevention|prevent interruption]] can be helpful. They also use numerous [[trap]]s, so it may be a good idea to have one [[party]] member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.

Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't [[popup]] until a party member approaches her [[spawn]] point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from [[flatbow]] or [[longbow]] range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her [[energy]] by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts [[Mark of Protection]] on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use [[Contemplation of Purity]] and remove Mark of Protection.
